resources.name: LiBC crystal structure (P6_3/mmc)

access.notes: Space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), Li at 2a (0,0,0), B at 2c (1/3,2/3,1/4), C at 2d (1/3,2/3,3/4). Lattice parameters at ambient: a≈2.714 Å, c≈7.146 Å.

resources.notes: Crystal structure known from literature; can be set up directly in the DFT code.

access.notes: Open-source DFT code. Other GGA-PBE capable codes (e.g., ABINIT, VASP) are acceptable.

resources.name: GGA-PBE pseudopotentials for Li, B, C

access.notes: SSSP efficiency library or PSlibrary pseudopotentials for Li, B, C with GGA-PBE. Norm-conserving or ultrasoft pseudopotentials may be used.
